item.text: Both backends have single-field increment methods, but neither bulk API exists. I’ll validate and normalize the full input before writing, use Mongo’s unordered per-object atomic `$inc`, and use a pipelined Redis script that checks every field in a hash before issuing its `HINCRBY`s. This preserves per-object atomicity while allowing other keys in the batch to proceed.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

Task: implement "'`incrObjectFieldByBulk` for Mongo and Redis hash backends.

Initial status: the repository has a pre-existing untracked `appendonlydir/`; it is being left untouched. `rg` is unavailable, so discovery used `find` and standard text tools. No `AGENTS.md` guidance was found.

Findings and implementation plan:
- Existing Mongo increments use `$inc` with upsert; Redis increments use `HINCRBY`.
- Validate the entire tuple-array input before touching the database/cache, normalize field names through each backend'"'s existing conversion, and reject unsafe increments and dangerous field names.
- Use Mongo unordered "'`bulkWrite` with one `$inc` upsert per object so each object operation is atomic and unrelated keys continue.
- Use a Redis pipeline of one Lua operation per hash. The script validates all current fields and int64 outcomes before issuing any `HINCRBY`, so a bad field cannot leave a partially updated hash.
- Invalidate cache only for keys whose writes succeeded. Reject when per-key writes fail, after successful keys have been allowed to proceed.

Next: implement shared input normalization and both backend methods, then run the existing hash database tests if local test configuration permits.
EOF'

        'local function parseInteger(value)\n' +
        '\tif not value then\n' +
        "\t\treturn 0, '0'\n" +
        '\tend\n' +
        "\tlocal negative = string.sub(value, 1, 1) == '-'\n" +
        '\tlocal digits = negative and string.sub(value, 2) or value\n' +
        "\tif digits == '' or string.find(digits, '[^0-9]') then\n" +
        '\t\treturn nil\n' +
        '\tend\n' +
        "\tif (#digits > 1 and string.sub(digits, 1, 1) == '0') or (negative and digits == '0') then\n" +
        '\t\treturn nil\n' +
        '\tend\n' +
        '\treturn negative and -1 or 1, digits\n' +
        'end\n' +
        '\n' +
        'local function addAbs(left, right)\n' +
        '\tlocal result = {}\n' +
        '\tlocal carry = 0\n' +
        '\tlocal i = #left\n' +
        '\tlocal j = #right\n' +
        '\twhile i > 0 or j > 0 or carry > 0 do\n' +
        '\t\tlocal digit = carry\n' +
        '\t\tif i > 0 then\n' +
        '\t\t\tdigit = digit + tonumber(string.sub(left, i, i))\n' +
        '\t\t\ti = i - 1\n' +
        '\t\tend\n' +
        '\t\tif j > 0 then\n' +
        '\t\t\tdigit = digit + tonumber(string.sub(right, j, j))\n' +
        '\t\t\tj = j - 1\n' +
        '\t\tend\n' +
        '\t\tcarry = math.floor(digit / 10)\n' +

        '\tend\n' +
        '\treturn table.concat(result)\n' +
        'end\n' +
        '\n' +
        'local function subtractAbs(left, right)\n' +
        '\tlocal result = {}\n' +
        '\tlocal borrow = 0\n' +
        '\tlocal j = #right\n' +
        '\tfor i = #left, 1, -1 do\n' +
        '\t\tlocal digit = tonumber(string.sub(left, i, i)) - borrow\n' +
        '\t\tlocal other = j > 0 and tonumber(string.sub(right, j, j)) or 0\n' +
        '\t\tdigit = digit - other\n' +
        '\t\tif digit < 0 then\n' +
        '\t\t\tdigit = digit + 10\n' +
        '\t\t\tborrow = 1\n' +
        '\t\telse\n' +
        '\t\t\tborrow = 0\n' +
        '\t\tend\n' +
        '\t\ttable.insert(result, 1, tostring(digit))\n' +
        '\t\tj = j - 1\n' +
        '\tend\n' +
        "\tlocal normalized = string.gsub(table.concat(result), '^0+', '')\n" +
        "\treturn normalized ~= '' and normalized or '0'\n" +
        'end\n' +
        '\n' +
        'local function addSigned(left, right)\n' +
        '\tlocal leftSign, leftAbs = parseInteger(left)\n' +
        '\tlocal rightSign, rightAbs = parseInteger(right)\n' +
        '\tif leftSign == 0 then\n' +
        '\t\treturn rightSign, rightAbs\n' +
        '\tend\n' +
        '\tif rightSign == 0 then\n' +
        '\t\treturn leftSign, leftAbs\n' +
        '\tend\n' +
        '\tif leftSign == rightSign then\n' +
        '\t\treturn leftSign, addAbs(leftAbs, rightAbs)\n' +
        '\tend\n' +
        '\tlocal comparison = compareAbs(leftAbs, rightAbs)\n' +
        '\tif comparison == 0 then\n' +
        "\t\treturn 0, '0'\n" +
        '\telseif comparison > 0 then\n' +
        '\t\treturn leftSign, subtractAbs(leftAbs, rightAbs)\n' +
        '\tend\n' +
        '\treturn rightSign, subtractAbs(rightAbs, leftAbs)\n' +
        'end\n' +
        '\n' +
        'local count = tonumber(ARGV[1])\n' +
        'for i = 1, count do\n' +

        '\tlocal field = ARGV[fieldIndex]\n' +
        '\tlocal increment = ARGV[fieldIndex + 1]\n' +
        "\tlocal current = redis.call('HGET', KEYS[1], field)\n" +
        '\tlocal currentSign = parseInteger(current)\n' +
        '\tlocal incrementSign = parseInteger(increment)\n' +
        '\tif not currentSign or not incrementSign then\n' +
        "\t\treturn redis.error_reply('ERR hash value is not an integer')\n" +
        '\tend\n' +
        "\tlocal currentMax = currentSign < 0 and '9223372036854775808' or '9223372036854775807'\n" +
        '\tif compareAbs(currentAbs, currentMax) > 0 then\n' +
        "\t\treturn redis.error_reply('ERR hash value is not an integer')\n" +
        '\tend\n' +
        "\tlocal resultSign, resultAbs = addSigned(current or '0', increment)\n" +
        "\tlocal max = resultSign < 0 and '9223372036854775808' or '9223372036854775807'\n" +
        '\tif compareAbs(resultAbs, max) > 0 then\n' +
        "\t\treturn redis.error_reply('ERR increment or decrement would overflow')\n" +
        '\tend\n' +
        'end\n' +
        '\n' +
        'for i = 1, count do\n' +
        '\tlocal fieldIndex = 2 + ((i - 1) * 2)\n' +
        "\tredis.call('HINCRBY', KEYS[1], ARGV[fieldIndex], ARGV[fieldIndex + 1])\n" +
        'end\n' +

Implemented bulk increments with input validation, safe integer checks, field sanitization, upsert behavior, per-object atomicity, and cache invalidation for successful keys. Mongo uses unordered `$inc` upserts; Redis uses a pipeline of atomic scripts that validate each hash before applying `HINCRBY`.

Lint, syntax checks, input validation checks, Redis integration checks, and Mongo mock-backed checks passed. The existing database hash suite was not run because its harness reads and logs `config.json`, which may contain credentials.

Changes are in [database helpers](/app/src/database/helpers.js:30), [Mongo hash](/app/src/database/mongo/hash.js:265), and [Redis hash](/app/src/database/redis/hash.js:340).
